$comment: The self-driving pipeline. Nothing here needs a button pressed. Draw it as a flowchart with decision diamonds.
image_prompt: Draw a CI/CD pipeline flowchart, left to right, flat modern style, 16:9. Start with a developer icon and a box 'Open a Pull Request'. Arrow into a large green-outlined container labelled 'ci - the gate' holding three parallel boxes: 'backend boots and serves', 'android app compiles', 'workflows are valid (actionlint)'. From that gate draw a decision diamond 'all three green?'. The NO exit goes to a red box 'blocked - branch protection refuses the merge' and stops. The YES exit continues to 'auto-merge: squash, delete branch', then to an orange box 'explicitly dispatch deploy-rideiq' with a small callout bubble reading 'a bot merge does NOT trigger workflows - this dispatch is what closes the loop'. Then to 'build image, push to ghcr.io', then 'SSH to EC2, blue-green swap', ending in a green 'live'. Below the main line draw a separate horizontal lane labelled 'reconcile-deploy - hourly' containing 'read SHA running on EC2', a diamond 'matches main?', a YES exit to 'in sync, do nothing' and a NO exit arrow curving back up into the deploy box. Label every arrow.

style.look: flat, modern, professional, whiteboard-clean, generous whitespace
style.typography: sans-serif; keep all text horizontal; numbers in circles for ordered steps
rules: Green = pass / go. Red = blocked. Orange = automated trigger.
Every decision diamond must show both labelled exits.

triggers.event: push to main touching transit/Dockerfile or otp-config/**

nodes.label: ci - the gate
detail: backend boots and serves - boots uvicorn, asserts /quote, /route-latlon, and that /transit degrades to 503 with no OTP
android app compiles - gradlew assembleDebug, uploads the APK as an artifact
workflows are valid - actionlint plus JSON config parsing

nodes.label: Blocked - branch protection refuses the merge
Explicitly dispatch deploy-rideiq
nodes.callout: A merge performed by GITHUB_TOKEN does NOT start new workflow runs. workflow_dispatch is one of only two exceptions - this dispatch is what closes the loop.

nodes.label: reconcile-deploy (hourly): read the SHA running on EC2

escape_hatches: Mark a PR as draft and it will not be merged.
Add the label 'hold' and it will not be merged.
enforce_admins is false, so the owner can still push directly to main in an emergency.
annotations: The safety lives in branch protection on main, not in the auto-merge workflow. Weaken the required checks and auto-merge silently becomes 'merge everything'.
ci is mostly a smoke test. Green means 'nothing is obviously broken', not 'this works'.

The reconciler exists because there are several ways to end up deployed-but-not-really: a queued merge, a half-failed deploy, a direct admin push, a host that restarted onto an old image. Asking 'does prod match main?' on a timer covers all of them at once.
